a.title: foundation: turn on noUncheckedIndexedAccess, and say what a miss means
a.body: Enable noUncheckedIndexedAccess in the base tsconfig so an index into an array or a record reads as possibly missing, then fix every call site and write down what a miss means at each one.

b.title: tsconfig: strict index access for arrays and records
b.body: Set noUncheckedIndexedAccess: true in the shared compiler options so that array and record indexing is checked, matching the strictness the other flags already ask for.

source: v1: two cards filed a day apart for the same compiler flag by two peers who had not read each other's backlog - the duplicate-feature case the problem table names. Same flag, same files, same acceptance.
